gloss: to teach, to tell, to inform

definitions.explanation: Used when imparting knowledge or skills to someone. The person being taught is marked with に.
Used when sharing information like phone numbers, addresses, or directions with someone.

⟦{電話番号|でんわばんごう}→電話番号：10159_denwabangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おし}えて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: XにYを{教|おし}える (teach Y to X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action or occupation. {教|おし}えている = 'is teaching' or 'teaches (as a profession).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おし}える (teach Japanese)
・⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{教|おし}える (teach students)
・⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おし}える (tell/show the way)
・{教|おし}えて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please tell me)

Counterpart: ⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn from a teacher).
